title: Personal Finance Management System: A Chatbot-Based Personal Finance Management System Using Rule-Based Approach
authors: Al Rafi, A.; Ananna, N.T.; Arif, F.; Hassan, M.M.; Jahan, I.
tldr: A rule-based chatbot prototype using NLP and ML automates personal finance tracking and provides spending recommendations through natural language interaction.
problem_and_motivation: Manual personal finance management is difficult, error-prone, and tedious, leading to overspending, debt accumulation, and lack of savings. Existing chatbot solutions have not effectively addressed the needs of less tech-savvy individuals, and no single system fully covers income and expense tracking, financial planning, and savings management.
approach: Developed a chatbot-based PFM prototype using Python with rule-based natural language processing.
Applied Named Entity Recognition (NER) for input extraction, pattern matching, and rule-based logic for transaction processing.
Used NLP techniques including tokenization, tagging, and parsing via NLTK and SpaCy.
Trained a machine learning model on labeled data to recognize input intent, extracting features like category, amount, and date.
Integrated a financial model to evaluate savings based on monthly income and total spending.
Implemented a Flask backend server with MongoDB for data storage.
findings: num: The system achieved 95% accuracy in understanding and processing user queries.
num: 100% of tested transactions were correctly saved and categorized in the database.
num: 200+ test cases were used to validate the system.
num: 45% cost reduction observed in financial management operations.
num: 100% positive user satisfaction reported among testers.
The system successfully automates income and expense tracking, financial planning, and savings management.
The chatbot effectively extracts useful information from user inputs using NLP.

topic_relevance.contribution_to_field: This paper presents a prototype chatbot-based PFM system that automates transaction recording, categorization, and savings analysis using rule-based NLP. It demonstrates how NLP techniques can extract financial information from natural language inputs and provide personalized recommendations. The system achieves 95% accuracy and 100% user satisfaction, showing the viability of conversational AI for personal finance.
directly_justifies: Chatbot-based systems using NLP can automate personal finance management tasks like expense tracking.
Rule-based approaches with NER can effectively extract financial entities from natural language inputs.
Conversational interfaces reduce barriers for less tech-savvy users to manage finances.
limits: The system is a prototype with limited scope covering only income and expense tracking.
Rule-based approach may struggle with diverse or ambiguous user inputs compared to deep learning methods.
No integration with real banking systems or live financial data sources.
topic_relevance.topic_mapping_rationale: All 14 topic domains were systematically scanned. Domain 1 (Current Personal Finance Landscape) is directly relevant as the paper addresses personal finance management challenges and proposes an automated solution. Codes 1.A (Current State of Personal Finance Management) and 1.D (Behavioral Barriers) apply at high and medium relevance respectively. Domain 4 (Landscape of Existing Systems) is relevant as the paper surveys existing PFM tools (4.A). Domain 11 (Personalized User Engagement) is relevant through the chatbot interface (11.A). Other domains like 2 (User Perspectives), 3 (Psychology), 7 (Budgeting Strategies), 8 (Anomaly Detection), 9 (UX/UI), 10 (Privacy), 12 (Evaluation Frameworks), 13 (Savings/Debt), and 14 (Synthetic Data) do not directly apply.

limitations: Limited scope covering only income and expense tracking without investment management.
Rule-based NLP may not handle diverse or ambiguous user inputs as effectively as modern LLM approaches.
Prototype implementation with 200+ test cases; not validated at scale.
No integration with real banking APIs or live financial data feeds.
